story.title: From Madinah's market… to your home
story.lead: Al Nakhlah Al Mubarakah is a family-run boutique for premium dates at the heart of Madinah's Central Dates Market.
story.body1: We hand-select every variety from the finest harvests and make sure it reaches you fresh and carefully packaged, with the spirit of Saudi hospitality.
story.body2: For us, dates are part of identity and story — so beyond selling, we maintain a guide explaining every variety's origins, taste and storage, so you can choose with confidence and thought.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions — migrated from the store's official content.
faq.cta: Didn't find your answer? Contact us directly on WhatsApp.

items.a: Delivery within Madinah is free for invoices above 200 SAR; below that the fee (~SAR 20) is agreed in the conversation. Outside Madinah, delivery is arranged with you on WhatsApp depending on the destination. The details and the timing are agreed in the conversation.
Add what you want to the cart, then check out: choose how you would like to receive the order and how to pay, and send it to us. It becomes a ready WhatsApp message that reaches us directly.

The prices shown are the current shop prices per kilogram. Your order becomes final once it is confirmed with you in conversation (WhatsApp). For exact pricing by quantity, weight and grade, ask on WhatsApp or visit the store.
We pack orders in practical packaging that protects the dates during transport, adapted to the type, the quantity and the occasion of the order.

items.q: What is the difference between date varieties?
items.a: Each variety has a unique taste and texture. Browse the “Dates Guide” to learn about each one: origin, story, flavour and nutritional value.

payment.title: Payment method
payment.intro: There is no online payment on this site. Available methods: bank transfer, or cash on delivery as agreed.
payment.step1: Choose “Bank transfer” at checkout and your IBAN will be shown.
payment.step2: Transfer the order amount from your banking app or the branch, and keep the transfer receipt.
payment.step3: Send us the transfer notice on WhatsApp with your name and the order number.
payment.step4: We confirm receipt of the payment, then prepare your order with you to agree pickup or delivery.
payment.noOnlineTitle: Why is there no online payment?
payment.noOnlineBody: We do not display any payment gateway until the payment details are confirmed. Until then nothing is charged by anyone: the order is completed through WhatsApp or bank transfer.
payment.metaDescription: Payment methods available at Al Nakhlah Al Mubarakah in Madinah: bank transfer and cash on delivery. There is no online payment, and nothing is charged without your agreement.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: A short, plain summary of what the checkout collects, why, and what we never collect.
privacy.metaTitle: Privacy Policy — Al Nakhlah Al Mubarakah
privacy.metaDescription: What our checkout collects and why, and what we never do: no online payment, no data sharing, no analytics.

sections.heading: What we collect when you order
sections.body: When you place an order we collect your name, mobile number, email and address (for pickup or delivery). No card or bank-account details are collected, because the site has no online payment.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.body: To prepare your order, to message you on WhatsApp (bank-transfer receipt), to arrange pickup or delivery, and to answer any question by email.

sections.heading: What we never do
sections.body: We never sell or share your data with third parties, never send it to advertising or analytics services, and never store it outside the shop's own conversations (WhatsApp and email).

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Order conversations are kept by the shop and deleted on your request. There is no general customer database.

sections.body: The prices shown on the catalogue are the current ones. No order is final until we confirm it with you in conversation (WhatsApp).
